products.name: ✨ 11- liter premium pressure cooker ✨
products.desc:
- 11 Liter Premium Pressure Cooker (Silver)

*The Ultimate Family Cooker - Cook More, In Less Time!*

The *CROWN 11-Liter Pressure Cooker* is specially designed for large Pakistani families. Cook up to 1.5kg - 2.5kg meat, biryani, pulses, and vegetables in one go. Made from *High-Quality Silver Aluminum*, it is lightweight, rust-proof, and built to last for years.

*Material:*
High-Grade Food-Safe Aluminum (Silver Finish) - Heavy-duty, highly conductive, and 100% rust-free.

*Key Features:*

- *Extra Large 11-Liter Capacity:* Perfect for 7-9 family members. Ideal for family dinners, dawat & Eid.
- *70% Faster Cooking:* Saves up to 70% gas and time compared to a normal pot.
- *4-Layer Safety Protection:* Equipped with Safety Valve, Pressure Regulator (Seeti), Gasket Release System & Locking Lid - 100% blast-proof when used correctly.
- *Heavy Thick Base:* Extra thick base prevents food from burning and distributes heat evenly.
- *Heat-Proof Bakelite Handles:* Strong, comfortable grip that stays cool while cooking.
- *High-Quality Aluminum Lid:* With dual whistle system for perfect pressure control.
- *Easy to Wash:* Can be cleaned easily, no special coating to worry about.

*Benefits:*

1.  Cooks tough meat in just 15-20 minutes.
2.  Locks in nutrients, taste and flavor - makes food healthier.
3.  Drastically reduces your monthly gas bill.
4.  One pot for everything - Meat, Biryani, Pulao, Daal, Vegetables, Soups.
5.  Saves your time in the kitchen every day.

*⚠️ Safety Instructions / Harmful Use If Misused:*

Please read carefully - The cooker is 100% safe if used properly. Problems only occur with wrong use.

1.  *Do Not Overfill:* Never fill more than 2/3 full. For 11-Liter, fill max 7-8 liters. Overfilling can block the steam vent.
2.  *Never Heat Without Water:* Do not put an empty cooker on flame. It will damage the silver. ✨
